howto.name: Enter the current version
howto.text: Use a SemVer value such as 1.2.3 or v1.2.3-beta.1.

howto.name: Compare bump types
howto.text: Patch, minor, major, and prerelease candidates are calculated side-by-side.

howto.name: Copy the release version
howto.text: Use the chosen value in package manifests, tags, changelogs, and release notes.

faq.a: Yes. Versions like 1.2.3-beta.1 are accepted, and the prerelease bump increments the trailing number when present.
No. It only calculates version strings so you can copy the value into your release workflow.

Patch increments the third number, minor increments the second and resets patch, major increments the first and resets minor and patch. A prerelease is released instead of bumped: patch turns 1.2.3-beta.1 into 1.2.3. Build metadata is dropped.
